CS collection

API for collecting CS inquiries.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Cs/Cs_Xml.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required shoplinker_id string Shoplinker account
3. Required st_date string CS start date yyyymmdd
4. Required ed_date string CS end date yyyymmdd
5. sdt_time string Query start time hhiiss Query start time
6. edt_time string Query end time hhiiss Query end time
7. page_no string Page number If there are more than 500 CS records, specify a page number
8. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page The default is 500 records
9. mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code
10. cs_status string Whether to collect replies Allowed values
  1. - Collect all (DEFAULT) : NULL OR empty value
  2. - Collect unanswered inquiries : 001
  3. - Collect answered inquiries : 002

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<Csinfo>
		<customer_id>고객사코드</customer_id>
		<shoplinker_id>42917246</shoplinker_id>
		<st_date>20110709</st_date>
		<ed_date>20110711</ed_date>
		<page_no>1</page_no>
		<total_standard_count>500</total_standard_count>
                <mall_id>APISHOP_0021</mall_id>
    </Csinfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. shoplinker_order_id string Shoplinker CS number
2. reg_dm string Shoplinker CS registration date
3. product_name string Product name
4. mall_name string Marketplace name
5. mall_product_id string Marketplace product number
6. product_id string Shoplinker product code
7. cs_title string CS title
8. cs_contents string CS reason
9. cs_status string CS processing status Allowed values
  1. - Unprocessed : 001
  2. - Processing completed : 002
10. mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code ex) APISHOP_0003
11. mall_user_id string Marketplace account ex) Auction login ID -A123
12. cs_order_id string Marketplace order number ex) Auction order number - 12345883
13. total_count string Total CS count Located in the header tag
14. total_page string Total page count Located in the header tag
15. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page Located in the header tag
16. currently_page string Page number requested by the current call Located in the header tag
17. currently_count string Number of CS records returned by the current call header location
18. receipt_date string Marketplace CS receipt date
19. receipt_user_name string CS recipient For Smart Store, receipt_user_id is shown.
20. partner_product_id string Customer product code 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="EUC-KR"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<header>
		<total_count>300</total_count>
		<total_page>2</total_page>
		<currently_page>1</currently_page>
		<currently_count>100</currently_count>
	</header>
        <Csinfo>
            <cslist>
                <shoplinker_order_id>샵링커 cs코드</shoplinker_order_id>
                <reg_dm>CS 날짜</reg_dm>
                <product_name>상품명</product_name>
                <mall_name>쇼핑몰명</mall_name>
                <mall_product_id>쇼핑몰 상품번호</mall_product_id>
                <product_id>샵링커 상품번호</product_id>
                <cs_title>제목</cs_title>
                <cs_contents>CS 사유</cs_contents>
                <cs_status>CS 상태</cs_status>
                <cs_order_id>cs 주문번호</cs_order_id>
                </cslist>
        </Csinfo>
</Shoplinker>
